qa_pairs.question: What types of usage statistics are available for individual virtual machines in the Metrix portal's Cloud statistics section?
qa_pairs.answer: For each virtual machine, users can access usage statistics covering CPU cores, memory, disk bandwidth, IOPS (input/output operations per second), and network bandwidth.

qa_pairs.question: For what timeframes can users view the usage statistics of their virtual machines in the Cloud statistics section?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can view the usage statistics for their virtual machines for the last month, the last week, the last day, or the last hour.
